svg.title: UAV printed sleeve dipole (867 MHz) — technical drawing
svg.desc: UAV printed sleeve dipole (867 MHz) (sleeve-dipole-867) · Fairbeam 0.7.0 · third-angle projection · scale 1:5 · A4

g.text: 2. Metal parts are PEC; zero-thickness sheets are drawn with a minimum
line width (solid black when seen edge-on).
3. Dashed lines: metal hidden behind a dielectric.
4. P1: lumped port, 50 Ω, along z, gap 2 mm, excited.
Upper arm length (above the feed gap)
Sleeve width (both strips and the coax slot)
Feed gap (sleeve top to upper arm)
Slot between the coax and each sleeve strip
Height of the bridge at the sleeve top (braid solder pad)
Board margin above the arm and below the sleeve
